title: Snack Chef
shareTitle: Snack Chef — Make playful fruit snacks
description: Spread, peel, slice, pour, and arrange six playful snacks — from fruit faces to rainbow plates and yogurt parfaits — in a warm storybook kitchen.
learningGoals: Follow a short picture recipe from beginning to end
Practice controlled circular, directional, and sustained-hold finger movements
Arrange ingredients with spatial planning, color grouping, and simple symmetry
Build positive familiarity with food preparation
interactionModel: broad scrub, swipe, peel, hold-to-pour, and strand-proof drag gestures with tap-to-place alternatives
feedbackModel: food changes directly under the finger, gentle spoken modeling, warm tactile sound effects, and a plated storybook reveal
